description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for working with a reftable data structure, including functions for initializing iterators and blocks, and retrieving table names.

methods.name: reftable_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the provided reftable table.

methods.name: table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the reftable table based on the specified type.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a block within the reftable by reading from the table at a specified offset and with a specified type.
